name: @vict-trading/trading-kit
description: Headless replay capability: market-time replay clock with a hard future-guard, clock-capped and evidence-recorded data queries (R1), honest availability semantics with explicit missing intervals (R2), drawing visibility provenance rules (R3/D-003), and a replay session persisted only through a consumer-supplied port. Renders nothing, fetches nothing, owns no storage, zero runtime dependencies.
